name: Kabli Pulao
description: Fragrant Kabli pulao with tender beef or mutton, basmati rice, carrots and raisins, finished gently so the rice stays separate.
ingredients: 1 kg beef or mutton, cut into serving pieces
4 cups basmati rice, rinsed and soaked
Whole spices, such as cardamom, cloves, cinnamon and bay leaf
method: Cook the beef or mutton with water and salt until tender, then remove the meat and reserve the cooking stock for the rice.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the sliced onions evenly. Add the whole spices and cumin and stir briefly until aromatic.
Measure the reserved stock according to the rice you use, bring it to a boil and check the salt before adding the drained soaked rice.
Cook until most of the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is close to tender, then arrange the cooked meat with the rice without aggressively stirring the grains.
In a separate small pan, sauté the carrot strips until slightly softened, add the raisins briefly so they plump without burning, and spread the mixture over the rice.
Cover tightly and steam on low heat until the rice is fully tender and separate.
Rest for a few minutes off the heat, then fluff gently and serve with the carrot-raisin topping distributed through or over the pulao.
